en: This is a black-and-white postcard featuring a portrait of a young man in formal attire on the left, framed with a decorative border. On the right side, there is a block of printed text in Portuguese, paying tribute to Raphael Xavier de Carvalho, a volunteer soldier who died heroically in 1915 during World War I, specifically in the Battle of Champagne, France. The lower part of the image has a caption with the title 'O Espelho' and the location 'Londres, 1915'.
